_comment: Layout of one scanned budget book, read by scripts/extract_scanned.py. Copy this file for another year and change what differs.
document_note: File is named 'Adopted' but its budget column is headed '2026 PROPOSED'. Values are labelled as the document labels them (doc_type 'proposed').

line_items._comment: Pages whose header matches every column below, left to right. 'header' is a regex matched against the column's stacked header words joined with spaces.

staffing._comment: Staffing schedule rows: org, object, title, bargaining unit, FT/PT, then one (count, salary) pair per column.

funds._comment: Org-code prefix (first 3 digits of 8-digit codes) -> fund. 7-digit codes are General Fund.

general_fund_department_overrides._comment: Per the 2026 General Fund Expense Summary (p3), Human Resources (1405) sits under Admin. Services; only Controller/Treasurer is split out.
